name: routing-opens-across-profiles
description: A URL typed in the command bar that a rule claims for a space on ANOTHER profile opens there and nowhere else. Personal (Default) is active with one row; Work belongs to the Second profile and starts empty. The report this pins: the command bar used to add the tab to Personal first, the throttle cancelled that tab's load a task later, and only then did the window switch, reopen in Work and close the Personal copy - four visible steps where the user expects one. So the measurement is not the end state alone. A MutationObserver armed on Personal's own pane before Return records the HIGHEST row count that pane ever showed; a build that adds and then removes the tab reaches 2 there, a correct build never leaves 1. The vlog order proves the switch came before the open, and the absent 'source tab closed' proves no reopen-and-close ran.

actions.expression: (() => { const pane = document.querySelector('.railpane[data-space-index="0"]'); if (!pane) { return 'no personal pane'; } window.__maxRows = pane.querySelectorAll('.tabrow').length; new MutationObserver(() => { window.__maxRows = Math.max(window.__maxRows, pane.querySelectorAll('.tabrow').length); }).observe(pane, {childList: true, subtree: true}); return 'armed'; })()
